The '''Imperial Reclamation Service''' was a military unit in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that conducted [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] research and field expeditions to recover ancient artifacts and technologies. The unit was active for over 1,300 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] from after the time of the Sith resettlement of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] through the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]] and conducted excavations and other archaeological activities on Imperial and non-Imperial [[Planet/Legends|planets]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. These archaeological exploits and the acquisition of powerful relics had the aim of enhancing the power of the [[Sith Order (Sith Empire)|Sith]] but also often required the Service to combat the threats represented by such relics.

==Description==
{{Quote|Unofficial motto of the Imperial Reclamation Service: When all else fails, try a blowtorch.|Lt. Talos Drellik to Lord Kallig|<ref name="Lost Mentor">{{TORcite|type=conversation|[[Talos Drellik]]|Lost Mentor}}</ref>}}
The Reclamation Service was a unit in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire commanded by an officer holding the rank of [[General/Legends|general]]. From the time of its establishment until the reforms of the [[Dark Council]] implemented by Empress [[Darth Acina|Acina]], the unit's archaeological activities were subject to the oversight of the Sith Order's [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge]]. After the reforms, control of the unit's operations was assumed by the new [[Sphere of Sith Doctrine]]. The unit regularly formed temporary expedition and excavation units for specific operations that were dissolved at the conclusion of the mission. A trackers' committee was a permanent organization in the unit.

The Dark Council founded the Service to search for powerful Sith artifacts across the galaxy. In its early days, its scope was expanded to include any ancient religious or technological relics of any culture that promised to enhance the Empire's power. The service was occasionally regarded suspiciously or derisively by ordinary soldiers, though Sith Lords and senior officers recognized the service's potential to single-handedly change the Empire's war with the Republic.<ref name="TORC" />

===Expeditions===
{{Quote|Never a dull moment when it comes to Sith archaeology, you know.|Dr. Talos Drellik to the Alliance Commander on Yavin 4|<ref name="Fighting Power With Knowledge" />}}
Many of the Service's archaeological field activities such as surveys and excavations were executed by organized expeditions. Expeditions were formed to fulfill a specific mission and were dissolved at the completion of the mission. The expeditions were commanded by either a Reclamation Service military officer or a senior scientist or [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]]. The ranks of the expeditions often included [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologists]], researchers and research assistants, historians, consultants, work foremen, workers, [[Scout/Legends|explorers]], [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]], salvagers, security personnel, and other scientific and support positions. Slave labor was sometimes used for more arduous and mundane tasks.

Since its founding, the Reclamation Service deployed archaeological expeditions during both peace and wartime, though its activities were ultimately aimed to strengthen the Empire in its conflicts with its ancient enemies, the Republic and Jedi. Expeditions were deployed to Imperial-controlled planets and neutral or unaligned planets as well as hostile worlds. On Imperial planets, the Service exercised authority and had access to resources allowing it to conduct large-scale excavations to unearth valuable artifacts. On neutral and hostile worlds, the Service conducted its operations covertly to avoid detection and prevent artifacts from being obtained by hostile forces.<ref name="TORC" />

Prior to [[3643 BBY]], Reclamation Service [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barden Golah]] had led expeditions to [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], [[Malachor II]], and [[Nim Drovis]].<ref name="Expedition into the Unknown" /> In 3643 BBY,<ref name="3643BBY">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> following an unauthorized breach of the [[Dark Temple]] by ambitious [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], the Dark Council sanctioned follow-on expeditions to discern the temple's status; one of which was led by service [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Swaine Lothar]] to excavate powerful relics near the temple.<ref name="The Accursed" /> Later that year, Cpt. Golah led an [[Reclamation Service Tatooine expedition|expedition]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] investigating leads to a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] base containing a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[mind prison]] housing an ancient intelligence.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" /> Sometime before [[3641 BBY]], service [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Talos Drellik]] participated in an expedition to [[Krayiss II]] which encountered insane [[Force ghost/Legends|Force apparitions]].<ref name="TalosMakeb">{{TORcite|type=location|Ambient dialogue with [[Talos Drellik]]|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>  Lt. Drellik led a team to investigate the possible location of a mysterious Sith temple on Hoth in 3641 BBY.<ref name="Into the Assassin Temple" />. Shortly thereafter, renowned service scholar [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Auselio Gann]] conducted a solo expedition on [[Aduba-6]] in search of the [[Tomb of Vaius Antinus's apprentice|tomb]] of [[Vaius Antinus]]' [[Vaius Antinus's apprentice|apprentice]] but died defending its secrets from the Sith and Jedi.<ref name="Finishing the Work" /> Before [[3640 BBY]], a service expedition in the [[Dead Corals]] on [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]] discovered references to an ancient Rakatan warlord.<ref name="Endless Horrors" /> Around [[3631 BBY]], the Dark Council commanded Talos Drellik to lead an expedition on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to discern similarities in technology associated with the former [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] to better understand [[Zakuulan]] tech.<ref name="Fighting Power With Knowledge" />

===Equipment===
{{Quote|Reclamation Service protocol for contaminated sites mandates atomic heat-cleansing of everything within a hundred-meter radius.|Cpt. Barden Golah briefs Imperial heroes on Tatooine|<ref name="The Ghosts of the Desert" />}}
A variety of equipment and tools were utilized by Reclamation Service personnel in their archaeological field operations to assist them in activities ranging from surveys and excavations to analysis and research. [[Portable scanner/Legends|Scanners]] were often used to obtain readings and other scientific data about objects of interest. [[Sonic excavator]]s were available to assist in site excavation. [[Holopad/Legends|Holopads]], signal devices, and other communications equipment was regularly used. Explosive materials such as [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] were used for excavation or containment activities. Some missions required the use of materials specific to an operating environment, such as [[Salt/Legends|salt]] in snowy or icy areas.<ref name="Scouring the Wastes" /> Reclamation Service personnel also carried personal identification cards.<ref name="Into the Maw" />

Many types and models of droids were used by the Service to perform a variety of tasks as well. The types of droids used ranged from hauler, salvage, recon, protocol, and other. Some of the models in use included the [[Shalora]] probe droid,<ref name="Scouring the Wastes" /> the [[Seneschal-series factotum droid]] (such as [[AD-304]]),<ref name="New Frontiers" /> K-X29 Excavator excavation droids, OT-13 Exterminator security droids, and P-B12 Detonator remote blasting droids.<ref name="Secrets of the EnclaveRep" />

[[File:Trason.png|thumb|right|250px|Reclamation Service uniforms were easily distinguishable by the tan colored caps and trousers.]]
Reclamation Service personnel were distinguishable by the unique color scheme of their military uniforms. The cap and trousers bore a tan or brownish color clearly identifying the wearer as a Service member.

===Areas of study===
{{Quote|The Reclamation Service is mandated to study all dangerous alien technology.|Specialist Nattis to Imperial heroes on Belsavis|<ref name="Found in Translation" />}}
The mission of the Reclamation Service required its members to develop an intensive historical and scientific knowledge of various ancients civilizations and cultures. Since the Service was initially founded to seek out powerful artifacts associated primarily with the Sith, that was the culture many the Service's personnel specialized in and their operations was centered on. Many archaeologists and scholars in the Service specialized in Sith history and archaeology that covered Sith history since the time before the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] to its more recent history following the resettlement of Dromund Kaas. The Service was similarly engaged in activities focused on Sith not directly associated with their own empire such as the fallen Jedi [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] and [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. Because the Sith desired the Reclamation Service to discover and study powerful ancient objects, often with a Dark side association, to be exploited for their use, the Rakata and their technologies were another common area of study for Imperial archaeologists. Powerful relics and artifacts that could enhance the power of the Sith and aid them in their wars were subject to the attention of the Service, and this included non-Dark side cultures such as the Gree and Jedi as well.

In addition to the various cultures under its scrutiny, the Reclamation Service engaged in different types and areas of historical and archaeological study as well. These included fields such as [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeology]],<ref name="The Ghosts of the Desert" /> military history, antique weaponry, and archaeological warfare.<ref name="The Big Find" />

===Discoveries===
{{Quote|The path to items of power is paved with pottery shards and broken carvings.|Lt. Talos Drellik to Lord Kallig|<ref name="Welcome Talos" />}}
Some of the various archaeological expeditions deployed by the Reclamation Service across the span of decades uncovered significant archaeological discoveries and artifacts. Many of these relics were delivered to Dromund Kaas after discovery for further analysis.

===Locations===
{{Quote|Never go to a dig site on your own, and never go without making sure someone knows. Second rule of archaeology.|Lt. Talos Drellik to Lord Kallig|<ref name="Old Friends" />}}
[[File:Reclamation_Service_Outpost_701.png|thumb|left|250px|The Reclamation Service operated various installations throughout the galaxy to support their local archaeological activities such as Outpost 701 on the desert planet Tatooine (pictured).]]
Like any military unit, the Reclamation Service made use of different types of installations to serve as their bases of operations in areas where they conducted archaeological activities.

Among the service's installations active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] was the [[Imperial Special Ops Center]]<ref name="ISOC">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Imperial Special Ops Center]]|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] from which they attempted to gain access to a [[Darth Revan's complex|facility]] housing a [[Infinite Engine|relic]] associated with [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]]. On the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet Tatooine, the service established several bases which supported their main expedition on the world including their [[Mos Ila Reclamation Service Base|research center]]<ref name="MIRSB">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Mos Ila Reclamation Service Base]]|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> in the settlement of [[Mos Ila]], a [[Reclamation Service Outpost 701|forward outpost]]<ref name="RSO701">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Reclamation Service Outpost 701]]|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> in the [[Jundland Chasm]], and a [[Abandoned Reclamation Service base|base]]<ref name="ARSB">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Abandoned Reclamation Service base]]|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> in the [[Southern Jundland Wastes]] which they later abandoned.

==History==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
{{Quote|From the depths of the ground, history calls us to save it from obscurity.|Lt. Talos Drellik to Lord Kallig|<ref name="Welcome Talos">{{TORcite|type=conversation|[[Talos Drellik]]|Welcome Talos}}</ref>}}
The Service was founded sometime after the establishment of the Dark Council after [[4980 BBY]] by [[Darth Zavakon]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
The Service's mission was to scour the galaxy to recover such ancient relics.<ref name="TORC" />

Sometime between the service's establishment and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Renigus Wight]], a former [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the Service, designed [[lightning spire]]s as safety devices to protect future service excavation teams from the tumultuous weather on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Lightning Spires">{{TORcite|type=codex|Lightning Spires}}</ref>

===Cold War===
The reemergence of the Sith Empire at the start of the [[Great Galactic War]] afforded the Reclamation Service the opportunity to expand its operations to planets across the galaxy that were previously inaccessible. On [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the Service's exploration of Sith tombs was hampered by widespread [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] infestations, though this this obstacle was offset a little by the availability of [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]] from the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]]. The Reclamation Service was in possession of information indicating the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], who had inhabited the planet for millennia, May have possessed knowledge with potential for extensive historical cross-checking.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

====Dromund Kaas====
By 3643 BBY,<ref name="3643BBY" /> the Service operated at least two archaeological camps south-east of [[Kaas City]] in the [[Riverfall Wilds]] just outside the city. That year, a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] carrying [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] infiltrators crash landed near one of the camps. The survivors proceeded under the cover as [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to the nearby camp and attempted to obtain archaeological supplies and uniforms from Service archaeological researcher [[Shellaster (archaeologist)|Shellaster]]. Shellaster, distracted by his work, directed the "spacers" to the next camp over, led by [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Nashal (individual)|Nashal]]. The infiltrators proceeded to next camp and assaulted it, killing Nashal and all but one member of the camp, research assistant [[Starforth]], and stealing archaeological researchers' uniforms, IDs, supplies, and a map for the purpose of infiltrating Kaas City disguised as Reclamation Service researchers. The map revealed the location of the [[Jurgoran Maw]], a hidden cave at the bottom of a nearby waterfall where the infiltrators proceeded to to regroup. Around this time, four Imperial heroes<ref name="Heroes">Throughout this article, the terms "Imperial heroes" and "Republic heroes" are used to signify the four playable classes of each faction in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. For the Imperial faction that is the Sith Warrior, Sith Inquisitor, Imperial Agent, and Bounty Hunter and for the Republic faction the Jedi Knight, Jedi Consular, Republic Trooper, and Smuggler.</ref> found a datapad at the infiltrators' crashed ship with apparent Republic encryption methods indicating their movement toward the nearby camp. The heroes pursued the infiltrators to the first camp and were similarly directed by Shellaster to Nashal's camp. Arriving at the next camp, the heroes encountered Starforth, who directed them to the Jurgoran Maw which the heroes assaulted, recovering the stolen supplies and returning them to Starforth, thus averting a security crisis.<ref name="Into the Maw">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Into the Maw|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>

Security for these Reclamation Service camps and the scientists and slaves working there was assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Molcarrus]] of the [[Third Recon Company]]. Around this time, local predators in the area, mainly [[vine cat]]s and [[yozusk]]s, had been attacking his men and the slaves under their charge, effectively bringing the camp's operations to a halt. In response to Molcarrus' request for assistance, officials in Kaas City issued a bounty on the beasts. Molcarrus enlisted the aid of the four Imperial heroes who killed at least ten of the beasts near the camps and delivered trophies from each as proof to Administrator [[Reese (Sith Empire)|Reese]] in Kaas City to collect the bounty. This effort significantly reduced attacks on the archaeological camp personnel by the jungle predators.<ref name="Jungle Hunt">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Jungle Hunt|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>

=====Dark Temple expeditions=====
{{Quote|Something's out there. I can feel it.|Reclamation Service Maj. Swaine Lothar briefs Imperial heroes on the dangers of the nearby Dark Temple|<ref name="The Accursed" />}}
[[File:Dark_Temple_pass.png|thumb|right|250px|Dozens of Reclamation Service personnel succumbed to the influence of the Dark side near the Dark Temple and were possessed by the spirits of long dead Sith Lords.]]
An unauthorized expedition of ambitious Sith Lords and their subjects breached the previously sealed and restricted Dark Temple around this time. By the end of the first week following the opening of the temple, no members of the expedition returned and the Dark Council authorized subsequent expeditions to deploy to the temple to determine its status.<ref>{{TORcite|type=codex|The Dark Temple}}</ref>

One such expedition was an excavation team led by Reclamation Service Major Swaine Lothar. This team uncovered several powerful Sith relics in the caverns of the [[Dark Temple pass]] but were attacked by other Imperials suffering from the oppressive [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] influence emanating from the temple. The possessed Imperials killed the team and took the relics to the temple grounds. When the four Imperial heroes encountered Lothar outside the [[Kaas City expansion district]], he reported his team as days overdue and solicited their aid in locating the team, retrieving the relics, and delivering them to the Sith Lord [[Duen]], overseer of the nearby [[Outpost Warden]]. The heroes entered the cavern and battling through possessed Imperials and Sith, discovered a holopad revealing the archaeological team's fate. Proceeding to the Dark Temple grounds, the heroes defeated multiple possessed and delusional Imperials and Sith, including Reclamation Service foremen and archaeologists, recovering the relics in their possession and delivering them to Lord Duen who quarantined them for further study.<ref name="The Accursed">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Accursed|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>

Meanwhile, operating from Outpost Warden, Captain [[Fizik]] of the Imperial Military had dispatched three expeditions, mostly comprised of slaves, to enter the Dark Temple to collect data on an increase in seismic activity in the area but none returned. When the Imperial heroes entered the temple and proceeded to the last known coordinates of the last expedition, they encountered a slave named [[Dorian]] who had been intermittently possessed by the spirit of long dead Sith Lord [[Nil Venerous]]. The heroes struck a bargain with the slave whereby they would recover stone tablets bearing Venerous' mark in exchange for the data sought by the Empire. The tablets Dorian desired had been stolen by other Imperials and Sith in the temple possessed by the spirits of Venerous' enemies who the heroes were compelled to kill to obtain the tablets. This included possessed Reclamation Service explorers.<ref name="The Wretch King">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Wretch King|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>

During this same incursion into the temple, the Imperial heroes accepted a mission from Sith Lord [[Alaric (Sith)|Alaric]] to recover a [[Plasma torch/Legends|plasma torch]] in the temple and seal three tombs of buried dead Sith Lords within.<ref name="Buried Power">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Buried Power|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref> While securing the Sith Lords' chambers, the heroes defeated nearly forty insane Imperials and Sith that had already escaped the temple. This included possessed Reclamation Service foremen, archaeologists, and explorers.<ref name="Bury the Insane">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Bury the Insane|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>

While completing other missions in the temple, the Imperial heroes encountered another possessed slave calling himself "Lord [[Pharshol]]."  Pharshol sent the heroes to search the temple for his apprentice, [[Anyarah]], and send her back to him. He claimed she had been led away by his rivals in the [[Dark Path]].<ref name="Secret Kinds of Darkness">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Secret Kinds of Darkness|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref> The heroes discovered Anyarah on the temple's second level in the Unquiet Chamber. To get to her, the heroes were compelled to defeat around ten Sith and Reclamation Service explorers possessed by Dark Path adepts and assassins.<ref name="Clearing the Dark Path">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Clearing the Dark Path|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>

====Nar Shaddaa: Infinite Engine discovery====
{{Quote|The Emperor has ordered me to unravel a great enigma in this sector: a complex constructed centuries ago by a Sith named Darth Revan. Upon its completion, Revan sealed a mysterious cargo inside, along with many alien slaves. Nothing has exited--or entered--since.|Reclamation Service Gen. Kolvin briefing Imperial heroes on his mission|<ref name="Ghosts of Nar Shaddaa" />}}
Centuries prior, [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] constructed a [[Darth Revan's complex|complex]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and sealed a mysterious device and many alien slaves inside. No one entered or exited the facility since that time on account of its fortifications which included self-repairing automated defense turrets and a seemingly endless supply of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]]. As early as [[3653 BBY]], the Sith Empire attempted to breach the complex but failed repeatedly, losing over 1,000 men and 10,000 [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]]. Finally, around 3643 BBY, the Sith Emperor assigned Reclamation Service General [[Kolvin (Human)|Kolvin]] as mission leader of the [[Imperial Special Ops Center]] in Nar Shaddaa's [[Upper Industrial Sector]] near Revan's complex and ordered him to unlock its secrets. Kolvin discovered that three reactors in the sector operated by factions hostile to the Empire powered the complex's defenses. He recruited the four Imperial heroes as a special strike team to assault and shut down the reactors to significantly mitigate the risk of accessing Revan's complex.<ref name="Ghosts of Nar Shaddaa">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Ghosts of Nar Shaddaa|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>

While disabling the reactors,<ref name="Blackout">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Blackout|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> the strike team defeated members of each enemy faction protecting them, including around ten members of the [[Exchange]],<ref name="Break up the Exchange">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Break up the Exchange|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> five [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] droids,<ref name="Shut Down the Hutt Cartel">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Shut Down the Hutt Cartel|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> and ten [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] soldiers.<ref name="Take out Republic Forces">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Take out Republic Forces|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>
{{GameDSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}} 
After successfully shutting down the reactors and disabling the complex's defenses, the strike team reported back to Gen. Kolvin who sent the team to investigate Revan's complex. Though most of the facility's defenses were disabled following the shutdown of the reactors, numerous droids still patrolled the complex. Upon entering the facility, the strike team destroyed at least fifteen of the droids to pave the way for the Empire to secure the facility.<ref name="Stop the Moving Parts">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stop the Moving Parts|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>  While investigating the facility, the strike team discovered three recordings produced over the previous centuries by Revan's alien slaves as well as Revan's own journal which revealed clues about the mysterious device contained in the complex and its history and that of the slaves.<ref name="Explore Revan's Past">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Explore Revan's Past|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>  The team finally encountered [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] slaves protecting Revan's device. One of the aliens, [[Azraj-Nug]] approached the team and revealed that the descendants of Revan's slaves still lived and nurtured the mysterious object known as the [[Infinite Engine]], a relic associated with the Rakatan [[Star Forge]]. The team defeated the handful of slaves and delivered the Infinite Engine to Gen. Kolvin who arranged for its transportation to Dromund Kaas for further study.<ref name="The Infinite Engine">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Infinite Engine|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>
{{EndGame}}
[[File:Infinite_Engine.png|thumb|left|250px|The Infinite Engine.]]

====Tatooine====
=====Main expedition=====
{{Quote|Somewhere in this wasteland is power enough to destroy a world, remake a galaxy.|Darth Silthar explains his expedition team's mission to Imperial heroes on Tatooine|<ref name="Expedition into the Unknown" />}}
{{Main|Reclamation Service Tatooine expedition}}
Around this time, the Empire discovered a damaged [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in deep space originating from a Czerka Corporation [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|base]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Czerka claimed to possess powerful local artifacts. The base disappeared shortly after the shuttle launch and Czerka never returned. Sith Lord [[Darth Silthar]] and Reclamation Service Captain Barden Golah led an expedition to Tatooine to discover the base and the artifacts contained within. The Imperial military occupied the Tatooinian settlement of [[Mos Ila]] and used the city as the expedition's base of operations.<ref name="Expedition into the Unknown">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Expedition into the Unknown|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

The expedition dispatched the Imperial heroes to a [[Sons of Palawa]] settlement near the city to obtain the [[Verbobrain/Legends|verbobrains]] of experimental battle droids believed to be of Czerka origin to help discover the location of the Czerka base.<ref name="Expedition into the Unknown" /> The heroes then took the verbobrains to a local [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] camp, whom the expedition had learned had traded the droids to the Sons, and obtained a Czerka lockbox containing an unknown device from them.<ref name="Masters of the Desert Machines">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Masters of the Desert Machines|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> Next, the heroes followed Silthar into [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] territory, discovering him fatally wounded in a cave, but having successfully discerned the general location of the Czerka base in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="Journey into Dust">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Journey into Dust|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> An accident while analyzing the Czerka device obtained from the Jawas caused an outbreak in a nearby Palawa village which was contained before the expedition continued.<ref name="The Ghosts of the Desert">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Ghosts of the Desert|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> Cpt. Golah dispatched the heroes to the Dune Sea to discover evidence of Czerka's presence, and they eventually discovered the base.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Thing Czerka Found|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

=====Other missions=====
In Imperial-occupied Mos Ila, Exchange smugglers were stealing Imperial explosives and selling them to the Republic. Reclamation Service Lieutenant [[Trason]] enlisted the assistance of the four Imperial heroes to recover the stolen explosive chemical compounds and break up the criminal smuggling ring in the city. The heroes obtained a signaling device used to alert the smugglers off an Exchange criminal and activated it at the gang's warehouse in the city and ambushed Exchange forces.<ref name="Plugging the Leak">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Plugging the Leak|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> The heroes destroyed ten Exchange security droids in the warehouse as well to further disrupt their operations.<ref name="Sweeping Up">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Sweeping Up|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

The Reclamation Service unearthed an abandoned Czerka compound near the settlement of [[Mos Anek]] which a band of Jawas entered and stole all the old droids contained therein. The droids activated and began occupying the area around the Jawas' [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]]. Reclamation Service Lieutenant [[Whist]] observed the droids' behavior developing. He enlisted the aid of the Imperial heroes as they passed through the settlement to destroy some of the droids and scan their memory cores to secure their technology for the Empire.<ref name="Artificial Intelligence">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Artificial Intelligence|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

In the Dune Sea, Reclamation Service officer [[Vengo]] and his men were escorting prison laborers to a Czerka dig site when they were ambushed by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led Republic forces who freed the prisoners. The prisoners were Republic officers detained illegally under the terms of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. Vengo overloaded the prisoners' shock collars which severely injured them and forced them to take shelter around the wreckage of the ''[[Tarsis'Krall]]''. The Imperial heroes were recruited by Vengo to track and kill the escaped prisoners<ref name="Prison Labor">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Prison Labor|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> and their Jedi rescuers.<ref name="Counter Rescue Operations">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Counter Rescue Operations|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

Following the success of the Reclamation Service's expedition on the planet, the Imperial heroes were recruited by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Merile Yurrion]], Imperial governor of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]], to help secure Tatooine as an Imperial stronghold in the region.<ref name="From Sand to Steel">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|From Sand to Steel|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> In the final part of that campaign, the heroes took on a mission from Reclamation Service Captain [[Tremont]] to displace the Exchange from an [[abandoned Reclamation Service base]] they converted into an ammunition stockyard in the Jundland Wastes. At the abandoned base, the heroes discovered a survivor from one of the previous [[Imperial Special Forces (Sith Empire)|Imperial Special Forces]] teams dispatched to destroy the Exchange's ammo stockpiles and obtained his explosives, using them to destroy the stockpiles.<ref name="Three Strikes">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Three Strikes|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>  To strike a crippling blow to the Exchange, the heroes defeated over thirty Exchange members and droids at the base,<ref name="EO1">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 1 - Enforcing Order|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> <ref name="EO3">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 3 - Enforcing Order|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> destroyed several of their weapons caches,<ref name="EO2">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 2 - Enforcing Order|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> and killed the local Exchange division commander, retrieving the Exchange's shipping records from his body detailing weapons and ammo shipments the Exchange brought through Tatooine and delivering them to Imperial authorities.<ref name="EOF">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Final Stage - Enforcing Order|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

While in the abandoned Reclamation Service base the heroes also destroyed a stockpile of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] the Exchange was selling to Imperial troops<ref name="War on Spice">{{TORcite|type=heroic|War on Spice|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> and destroyed their anti-aircraft defenses to allow Imperial reinforcements to seize their shipping warehouse.<ref name="Call Down the Thunder">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Call Down the Thunder|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> The Exchange had also seized several satellite uplink towers in the base they were using to slice Imperial databases. Reclamation Service Ensign [[Rosha (ensign)|Rosha]] solicited the aid of the Imperial heroes to acquire satellite uplink access codes from Exchange personnel and sabotage the links. A tracer planted by the heroes revealed that the Hutt's were paying for information on the Imperials collected by the Exchange.<ref name="Rogue Processes">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Rogue Processes|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

Near the abandoned Service base were ruins Reclamation Service Lieutenant [[Berrig]] and his team were assigned to research but they were driven out of the area by Republic archaeologists and their Republic Special Forces escort who sought to excavate the same site. Berrig enlisted the aid of the Imperial heroes to defeat several of the Republic archaeologists<ref name="Trespassing">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Trespassing|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> and their armed escort to clear the area so his team could resume their work.<ref name="Armed Escort">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Armed Escort|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

====Balmorra====
During the Galactic Republic's [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|final push]] of support to the [[Balmorran resistance|resistance]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] in [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="3642BBY">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> the occupying Imperial force shot down the ''[[Corvani]]'', piloted by freelance smuggler [[Ari Skyff]] who was delivering weapons and medical supplies to the Republic. Skyff convinced four Republic heroes to travel to the ''Corvani's'' crash site in the [[Gorinth Canyon]] where they retrieved the supplies from encroaching Imperial salvage teams led by Reclamation Service officers.<ref>{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Lost Love|[[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]}}</ref>  The heroes defeated several Reclamation Service officers and their salvage droids while recovering the supplies.<ref>{{TORcite|type=bonus|Wreckage Reclamation|[[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]}}</ref>

====The Foundry====
[[File:Foundry_Station.png|thumb|left|250px|The Foundry.]]
During the [[Battle of the Foundry]], as the four Imperial heroes progressed through the facility, they retrieved data from numerous ancient terminals to provide Reclamation Service officers with insights into the facility's secrets.<ref>{{TORcite|type=bonus|Forgotten Technology|the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]]}}</ref>  The Reclamation Service believed the Foundry used a network of tractor beams to retrieve and break down nearby asteroids to provide raw materials for its endless mass production.<ref>{{TORcite|type=codex|The Foundry}}</ref>

====Hoth====
=====Kallig's expedition=====
{{Quote|This must be the greatest discovery since my mentor Auselio Gann unearthed the wing of Naga Sadow's own fighter on Yavin Four!|Lt. Talos Drellik to Lord Kallig|<ref name="Bitter Rivalries">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Bitter Rivalries|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>}}
{{Main|Reclamation Service Hoth expedition}}
Around 3641 BBY<ref name="3641BBY">{{TOR_dates|3}},</ref> service Lt. Talos Drellik commanded a team on the ice planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in search of a mythical [[Sadow'een Temple|Sadow'een temple]]. The Sith Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] arrived on the planet pursuing rumors of the presence of a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] and assumed command of Drellik's team to aid in the search.<ref name="Scouring the Wastes">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Scouring the Wastes|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

[[File:Sadoween_Temple.png|thumb|right|250px|Lt. Talos Drellik led a Reclamation Service team to Hoth in search of a Sadow'een temple.]]
Drellik and his team successfully aided Kallig in discerning the location of the Sith temple they had originally been searching for and which Kallig's sought-after Force ghost directed them to in order to desecrate its contents in exchange for the ghost's aid.<ref name="Into the Assassin Temple">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Into the Assassin Temple|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref> The mission concluded in the successful discovery of the temple and the recovery of the ancient ghost's sarcophagus.<ref name="">{{TORcite|type=message|Horak-Mul|[[Engineer/Legends|Engineer]] [[Qualus Sorrel|Sorrel]]}}</ref>

=====Starship Graveyard missions=====
{{Quote|Have you been to the starship graveyard yet? Fascinating place. Discoveries left and right.|Reclamation Service Captain Vujaar describes the Starship Graveyard to Imperial heroes on Hoth|<ref name="The Big Find" />}}
Around this time, the Empire had been trying for months to lure the Jedi on the planet into a fight without success. Finally, several Jedi masters were spotted leading a detachment of Republic commandos to a site at the north end of the ''Star of Coruscant''. From Frostwake Outpost, [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] Captain [[Vujaar]], assigned to the Reclamation Service, enlisted the four Imperial heroes to go to the Jedi encampment and recover whatever they found. The heroes defeated numerous Jedi and Republic assault troopers<ref name="Aiding the Looters">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Aiding the Looters|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref> and recovered several Sith artifacts. Returning the relics to Vujaar, the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] officer identified the relics as associated with the Sadow'een and suggested they provided the locations of several Sadow'een temples across the galaxy.<ref name="The Big Find">{{TORcite|type=heroic|The Big Find|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

In the Starship Graveyard, [[White Maw]] pirates scavenged cargo manifests from crashed ships to gather information on their cargo. As this information was of great value to Reclamation Service excavation teams, the four Imperial heroes defeated numerous White Maw forces in the area, looted their encrypted datapads and a decryption key from their keyholder, and passed these materials on to [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] for decryption so the data could be forwarded to the Service.<ref name="Manifest Destiny">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Manifest Destiny|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

As part of the Empire's final push to displace the White Maw from the planet, the four Imperial heroes investigated a pirate hideout called [[Loramarr (location)|Loramarr]] where they discovered a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[neural chipset]], presumably designed by the inventor [[Loramarr]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Holtz]] and [[Fixer 308]] alerted the Reclamation Service to the area after it had been cleared to see if anything else might be discovered.<ref name="Spoils to the Victor">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Spoils to the Victor|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

===Galactic War===
====Auselio Gann's last expedition====
{{Quote|I've gone to the tomb of Vaius Antinus's unnamed apprentice, on Aduba Six. I don't understand why, but both Sith and Jedi are after this tomb and its secrets.|Dr. Auselio Gann's final recorded message to his protege, Lt. Talos Drellik concerning his last mission|<ref name="Finishing the Work" />}}
Doctor Auselio Gann, regarded as the Empire's premier scholar on Naga Sadow, met his pupil, Lt. Drellik, on Nar Shaddaa just prior to the latter's departure for the expedition to Hoth. Gann informed Drellik he was departing to [[Malachor III]] and gave Drellik a medallion before leaving.<ref name="Old Friends">{{TORcite|type=conversation|[[Talos Drellik]]|Old Friends}}</ref>

The medallion's outer layer responded to heat that melted away revealing a heat-resistant casing containing a [[Datachip/Legends|datachip]]. The chip contained information revealing Gann was searching the tomb of Vaius Antinus on Alderaan.<ref name="Lost Mentor" />

The medallion came with a newer chain<ref name="Failure">{{TORcite|type=conversation|[[Talos Drellik]]|Failure}}</ref> which contained a holofrequency with which Gann recorded a message for Drellik. In the message, Gann revealed that after visiting Antinus' tomb, he travelled to Aduba-6 to the tomb of Antinus' apprentice where he found both Sith and Jedi pursuing the tomb's secrets. In an attempt to preserve the history contained in the tomb, Gann used the tomb's traps against both Sith and Jedi but trapped himself in the prison where he died. Drellik discovered Gann's hidden message on the medallion shortly after joining Lord Kallig's crew, and pursued Gann to Aduba-6.<ref name="Finishing the Work">{{TORcite|type=conversation|[[Talos Drellik]]|Finishing the Work}}</ref>

====Belsavis====
{{Quote|The Reclamation Service has much more work to do on Belsavis.|Maj. Gart Charkron to Imperial heroes|<ref name="Unintended Consequences" />}}
[[File:Wraith_Box.png|thumb|left|250px|Reclamation Service teams accompanying the Imperial invasion force on Belsavis were entirely focused on technology and artifacts associated with the Rakata, such as the Wraith Box.]]
During the Imperial [[Invasion of Belsavis|invasion]] of the Republic prison planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] around 3641 BBY,<ref name="BelsavisDate">{{TOR_dates|Belsavis}}</ref> Reclamation Service special consultant Cpt. [[Konya Suladi]] led a team in the planet's [[Maximum Security Section]] that translated Rakatan writings referencing a planetary transportation system. They were ordered by [[Imperial Guard]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Calum]], the leader of the invasion, to get the system operational for Imperial military use in order to bypass Republic defenses. The writings referenced a nearby central transport hub, but none of the personnel Suladi dispatched to find it ever returned. Finally, Suladi solicited the aid of the four Imperial heroes to take a scanner to scan the transport device at the [[Rakata Transport Center|transport center]] in the [[Outer Wastes]]. The heroes successfully scanned the device and returned to Suladi who studied the findings and made the transport network available for Imperial deployment into the [[The Tomb|Tomb]].<ref name="Carving a Path">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Carving a Path|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>

Following the successful release of the [[Dread Masters]] from captivity in the Republic prison,<ref name="Terror in the Flesh">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Terror in the Flesh|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref> Imperial Guard Commander [[Vorel]] led an effort to claim Rakatan technology on the planet for duplication as a research space station. Vorel dismissed using the Reclamation Service to collect the technology, claiming the mission demanded the best and the Service was unqualified to lead the effort. The four Imperial heroes were recruited to spearhead the initiative, and after the [[Project Noble Focus|Domination Experiments]] were brought under Imperial control Vorel's strike team used the previously unlocked Rakatan planetary teleporters to advance into the Tomb to prepare the desired Rakatan tech for extraction.<ref name="Belsavis Reborn">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Belsavis Reborn|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref> Reclamation Service science officer [[Specialist/Legends|Specialist]] [[Nattis]] of Vorel's strike team observed that released [[Esh-kha]] warriors in the area seemed to be testing advanced alien weapons in their engagements with Imperial forces. The weapons afforded the Esh-kha a considerable technological advantage over Imperial forces which threatened to repel the Empire from the planet. The Imperial heroes proceeded to the nearby [[Forbidden weapons vault|weapons vault]] where the Esh-kha obtained the weapons and seized two dozen of the advanced blasters while defeating over a dozen Esh-kha warriors.<ref name="Vault Raider">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Vault Raider|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref> The heroes delivered the weapons samples to Nattis who analyzed them to develop a defense against against the new technology.<ref name="Found in Translation">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Found in Translation|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>

In the [[High Security Section]] of the prison, Reclamation Service Major [[Gart Charkron]] and his team excavated a tunnel in a [[Excavated Rakata vault|vault]] housing an ancient Rakatan device of unknown purpose at least 10,000 years old they designated the "[[Wraith Box]]" after an old Sith legend. The device, which carvings in the tunnel claimed granted great power, disintegrated three of Charkron's team members before he enlisted the assistance of the Imperial heroes to gather some key components to the device looted by loose prisoner and assemble the device. The device activated briefly after the heroes reassembled it. They delivered it to Charkron who took it to Dromund Kaas for study.<ref name="Unintended Consequences">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Unintended Consequences|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>

====Voss====
{{Quote|We've found disturbing evidence of an ancient link between the Jedi and the Voss. Jedi iconography--statues, to be exact--found in Voss ruins. If authentic, they could make the Voss sympathetic to the Republic.|Reclamation Service Sgt. Darrst reports recent findings to Imperial heroes|<ref name="HiWYMI" />}}
On [[Voss]], Reclamation Service Sergeant [[Darrst]] and his team discovered Jedi statues in local ruins indicating an ancient link between the Jedi and the native [[Voss (species)|Voss]] population. Concerned that a genuine link between the two groups might might make the Voss, whose favor the Empire sought, sympathetic to a Republic alliance, Darrst solicited the aid of the four Imperial heroes to examine the statues so their authenticity could be verified and to clear the area where the statues were located in [[Serenity Valley]] in the [[Old Paths]] of the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] presence to allow for follow-up surveys. After the heroes collected data confirming the authenticity of the statues and defeating over a dozen Gormak fighters in the area,<ref name="Clearing a Path">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Clearing a Path|[[Voss]]}}</ref> Darrst planned to instigate the destruction of the statues masked as a [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] to prevent the Voss from discovering their historical association with the Jedi.<ref name="HiWYMI">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|History is What You Make It|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

After completing several missions to win the favor of the Voss [[Three|leaders]],<ref name="A Long Forgotten Evil">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|A Long Forgotten Evil|[[Voss]]}}</ref> the Empire refocused its efforts on the planet to suppressing a rising insurgency in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] led by the Gormak chieftain [[Raklann]]. The Imperial heroes were directed to Sith Lord [[Pallas (Sith Lord)|Pallas]] who instructed the heroes to retrieve Sith artifacts looted by Gormak raiders<ref name="Looters">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Looters|[[Voss]]}}</ref> and assault a Republic archaeological dig.<ref name="Aggressive Archeology">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Aggressive Archeology|[[Voss]]}}</ref> With the ruins secured, reclamation teams moved in to conduct proper surveys.<ref name="The Outcast's Game">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Outcast's Game|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

====Corellia====
{{Quote|Sith, Imperials. The challenger has arrived. The Kaggath ends here. I've gathered you here to watch me wipe this degenerate from the face of the Empire.|Darth Thanaton addresses an audience in Coronet City’s government district gathered to witness his duel with Lord Kallig|<ref name="The Duel" />}}
Around this time, an ongoing feud between [[Darth Thanaton]], the Dark Council member for ancient knowledge and his rival, Lord Kallig, culminated in Thanaton's declaration of a [[Kaggath (Galactic War)|kaggath]] and the designation of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], then the site of an ongoing [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] between the Empire and Republic, as the battleground. At the conclusion of the conflict, Thanaton invited numerous senior Sith and Imperials on the planet to an audience chamber in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]'s [[Governmental Sector|government district]] to witness in person his anticipated victory in a [[Second duel on Corellia|final duel]] against Kallig. Reclamation Service officials were among the dignitaries present to witness Kallig's defeat of Thanaton and the Dark Councilor's retreat from the battlefield.<ref name="The Duel">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|The Duel|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref>

====Ilum====
{{Quote|The Imperials want Ilum's crystals. They're using deep-miners to drill into the planet's core! The excavations leave massive sink holes. The entire world's becoming unstable. If we don't stop them, Ilum could literally crack in two.|Republic Supreme Commander Rans briefs Republic heroes about an Imperial raid on Ilum|<ref name="Crystal Ball" />}}
[[File:Mephite_crystal_mines.png|thumb|right|250px|Mine workers from the Reclamation Service supported the main Imperial mission on Ilum by assisting the harvesting of Adegan crystals.]]
Reclamation Service forces accompanied an Imperial invasion force to [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during [[Battle of Ilum|Operation Dark Ice]], the Empire's effort to harvest [[Adegan crystal/Legends|adegan crystals]] for use in developing a stealth fleet. Service personnel directly assisted the mission by serving as mine workers operating [[deep-miner]]s and other equipment in several crystal mines in the [[Eastern Ice Shelf]].<ref name="Crystal Ball">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Crystal Ball|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref> Many of these Service personnel were defeated by Republic heroes as they secured the caves.<ref>{{TORcite|type=bonus|Excavation|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref>

A sizable Reclamation Service force was gathered along the [[Road to Glory]] near the planet's [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)/Legends|Jedi temple]] where a Republic [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was shot down.<ref name="Pilot Down">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Pilot Down|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref>

Following the defeat of [[Darth Malgus]]' failed [[New Empire|rebellion]], signaled by the self-destruction of the [[Emperor's Fortress|Emperor's space station]], the Reclamation Service combed the wreckage for valuable items or information.<ref name="An Empire Betrayed">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|An Empire Betrayed|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref> The space station possessed a considerable amount of ancient technology, including from [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] and Rakata sources.<ref name="The Emperor's Space Station">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Emperor's Space Station}}</ref>

====Belsavis: Eternity Vault discovery====
{{Quote|The legends say it took an army to stop the Infernal One before the Rakata and the other ancients locked him away with his weapons. If we don't do anything, though... well, the war against the Republic may be nothing next to what'll come.|Reclamation Service commander Gen. Threnoldt briefs Imperial heroes on the threat of the Infernal One|<ref name="Endless Horrors" />}}
[[File:Soa.png|thumb|left|250px|The danger posed to the galaxy by the potential escape of the ancient Rakatan warlord known as the Infernal One constituted one of the greatest threats the Reclamation Service sought to contain.]]
Around this time, an Imperial [[bombing run]] on Belsavis uncovered a new section of the planet's ancient prison called the [[Eternity Vault]] by the Rakata who built it. The section had been sealed for 20,000 years and contained no exit to the planet's surface. It's principal prisoner was an ancient Rakatan warlord known as the [[Soa|Infernal One]] who was locked away by the Rakata along with his most powerful followers and weapons. To confront this galactic threat and prevent the Infernal One from escaping the prison, Gen. [[Threnoldt]], the commander of the Reclamation Service, recruited a strike team to deploy to Belsavis and defeat the ancient warlord. Once the Infernal One's demise was secured, Threnoldt arranged for the deployment of additional forces to study the vault and its contents.<ref name="Endless Horrors" />

====Asation====
{{Quote|You've secured the greatest discovery in Reclamation Service history.|Col. Jadick to Imperial heroes following the discovery of a Gree hypergate on Asation|<ref name="New Frontiers" />}}
[[File:Grand_Hypergate.png|thumb|right|250px|The Grand Hypergate on the Gree world of Asation was opened by the Dread Masters' servants to sow chaos across the galaxy.]]
In [[3639 BBY]],<ref name="AsationYear">{{TOR_updates|1.4}}</ref> the Gree planet [[Asation]] was attacked by [[Dread Host]] forces who opened the planet's [[hypergate]] to allow monstrosities through to wreak havoc on the galaxy. Seeking aid, Gree emissaries met with both Republic and Imperial officials to combat the threat on their planet. [[Administrator General]] [[Lalat'k]] met with representatives from the Sith Empire, signifying the first contact between the two civilizations. After [[Darth Marr]] and the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] gave approval for talks to commence, Reclamation Service [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jadick]] was brought in as a translator. Jadick recruited a strike team to deploy to Asation to contain and eliminate the threat with the prospect of an Imperial-[[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] alliance if the mission succeeded.
{{GameDSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
After a successful [[Raid on Asation|assault]] on Asation's hypergate, Lalat'k proposed the Empire commit military forces to Gree space to enforce his rule as a dictator in the Enclave in exchange for allowing the Reclamation Service, which he referred to in his [[Gree (language)|own language]] as the "Empire researcher caste," access to Gree technology. Darth Nox, formerly Lord Kallig and the recently ascended head of the Sith Order's Sphere of Ancient Knowledge since the fall of Darth Thanaton, agreed to the terms and promised to commit forces to the endeavor. The Dark Councilor ordered Jadick to organize a team and deploy to Asation to undertake a study of the Gree technology.<ref name="New Frontiers">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|New Frontiers|the ''[[Ziost Shadow]]''}}</ref>
{{EndGame}}

====Seline====
{{Quote|We've created this replica of the ancient Seline ruins for training purposes. The objective is to capture them before the opposing team can. The scenario revolves around the ruins' ancient security system, which is powered by two energy pylons nearby.|A Reclamation Service officer explains a training scenario to an Imperial team|<ref name="GU 1.6" />}}
A few months later,<ref name="SelineYear">{{TOR_updates|1.6}}</ref> Imperial and Republic forces engaged one another on the planet [[Seline]] seeking control of the local Gree hypergate. Reclamation Service officers were present to advise Imperial forces on the capabilities and dangers of the hypergate. Sometime later, they replicated the Seline ruins as a scenario for combat training.
<ref name="GU 1.6">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' Game Update 1.6 "Ancient Hypergate"</ref>

====Makeb====
The [[3638 BBY|following year]],<ref name="MakebYear">{{TOR_updates|2.0}}</ref> Darth Marr recruited the Imperial heroes to secure a valuable substance called [[isotope-5]] on [[Makeb]] which was needed to bolster the Empire's defenses.<ref name="Countdown to Doomsday">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Countdown to Doomsday|[[Makeb]]}}</ref> Reclamation Service personnel were present at the Imperial [[Makeb orbital station|space station]] orbiting the planet and the [[Drill Site Control Center|abandoned drill site observation ring]] above one of the planet's [[Abandoned mining mesa|mining mesas]] where Marr's strike team established its second base of operations.

====Rishi====
{{Quote|My lord, my experience... says that pursuing mysteries such as this often leads even the wisest Sith to insanity. History is clear.|Talos Drellik cautions Darth Nox about Lord Veijel's research on Rishi|<ref name="Secrets of the Darkest Stars">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Secrets of the Darkest Stars|[[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]}}</ref>}}
In [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="RishiYear">{{TOR_updates|3.0}}</ref> Talos Drellik accompanied Darth Nox to a meeting with the Sith Lord [[Veijel]] of the Sphere of Ancient Knowledge on the planet [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. Veijel had been conducting research on the planet for the previous three decades and eventually established contact with presumed inhabitants of the nearby [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]]. The communications included instructions for modifying Veijel's communications arrays, which he followed and later reached out to Darth Nox to examine the machines. Drellik advised Darth Nox to act cautiously regarding Veijel's discovery.<ref name="Secrets of the Darkest Stars" />

====Yavin 4====
{{Quote|I'm begging you--if you won't hold your fire around the temple, at least remove any artifacts for preservation. I can't do this alone.|Reclamation Service Lt. Sabri appeals to Galactic heroes for assistance|<ref name="Altars of History" />}}
Toward the conclusion of the [[Revanite crisis]] a short time later, Imperial and Republic heroes accomplished several missions on Yavin 4 to secure a path to the [[Temple of Sacrifice]] and achieve greater cooperation and trust among the temporarily aligned Imperial and Republic forces operating on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="The Enemy Within">{{TORcite|type=general|The Enemy Within|[[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]}}</ref> Among the missions the heroes accepted was a charge from Reclamation Service Lt. [[Sabri]], the only Service member authorized to be on the moon during ongoing operations against the [[Order of Revan|Revanites]], to recover several Sith relics in the [[Temple Ruins|ruins]] around the temple to ensure their preservation. The heroes defeated over a dozen [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors while securing the relics<ref name="Massassi Onslaught">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Massassi Onslaught|[[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]}}</ref> and after delivering them to Sabri, she ensured they would be studied and delivered to Darth Nox's vaults and that further archaeological pursuits would follow after the Revanite threat was suppressed.<ref name="Altars of History">{{TORcite|type=daily|Altars of History|[[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]}}</ref>

===War against Zakuul===
{{Quote|Knowledge is power and here lays the closest technological cousin of the Eternal Empire: the Temple of Sacrifice.|Dr. Talos Drellik explains the focus of his expedition to the Outlander|<ref name="Fighting Power With Knowledge" />}}
{{Main|Reclamation Service Yavin 4 expedition}}
After the disappearance of his master, Darth Nox, at the start of the [[Eternal Empire]]'s galactic [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] around [[3636 BBY]], now Doctor Talos Drellik was ordered by the Dark Council to return to the service to lead an expedition to Yavin 4. Drellik's mission was to study the Temple of Sacrifice's mechanisms which he theorized may have shared traits with other technology constructed by the Sith Emperor, principally that associated with the Eternal Empire. Shortly after the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the Eternal Empire was founded [[3631 BBY|five years later]]<ref name="KotFEYear">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref>, the [[Alliance Commander]] traveled to Yavin 4 to recruit Drellik after assisting him in recovering several artifacts across the moon.<ref name="Fighting Power With Knowledge">{{TORcite|type=general|Fighting Power With Knowledge|[[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]}}</ref>

[[File:Akghal_Usar.png|thumb|left|250px|The Yavin 4 expedition concluded with the discovery of Ak'ghal Usar, a Dashade Shadow Killer held captive in stasis by the former Sith Emperor for over 300 years.]]
Drellik's team remained on Yavin 4 under the direction of Dr. [[Narissa Delau]] but did not make much progress until the discovery of another artifact several months later.<ref name="DashadeYear">{{TOR_updates|4.2}}</ref> At the request of Drellik, the Alliance Commander returned to Yavin 4 and resumed the archaeological investigation, encountering the [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Shadow Killer]] [[Ak'ghal Usar]] held in stasis prison.<ref name="Reclaimed Treasure">{{TORcite|type=general|Reclaimed Treasure|[[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]}}</ref>

===Third Galactic War===
[[File:Malgus-Disorder.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Reclamation Service was among the Imperial organizations that took the lead in hunting the treacherous Darth Malgus.]]
Another outcome of the Battle of Corellia was the disappearance of Darth Malgus. Malgus suffered severe injuries in the assault on the [[Meridian Complex]] that warranted immediate medical attention, but after he removed physical loyalty safeguards from his body, he stole an Imperial medical droid and shuttle and abandoned the Empire.<ref name="Objective Meridian" />

Sometime later, [[Sith Intelligence]] intercepted a Jedi transmission revealing Malgus had entered the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The Reclamation Service proposed deploying a full excavation unit to investigate the ruins and detain Malgus.<ref name="Secrets of the EnclaveImp">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Secrets of the Enclave|[[Odessen]]}}</ref> The Imperial team was led by the since promoted Col. Barden Golah. Golah's forces engaged a small strike team from [[Task Force Nova]] in the enclave ruins but Golah escaped after learning new information about Malgus' intentions.<ref name="Secrets of the EnclaveRep">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Secrets of the Enclave|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>

A few months later, Golah updated leaders in the [[Hand of the Empire]] on progress in the hunt for Malgus. Golah's team learned that a relic stolen by Malgus in the Dantooine Enclave had an association with an ancient Sith named [[Darth Nul]].<ref name="Whispers in the Force">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Whispers in the Force|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>

==Members==
{{Quote|Without Silthar, we're just archaeologists with guns.|Cpt. Barden Golah laments the death of Darth Silthar on Tatooine|<ref name="Journey into Dust" />}}
The Reclamation Service's ranks were comprised of a mix of archaeologists and scholars working with experienced officers given a crash course in history.<ref name="TORC" /> Most of the service's members were [[Human/Legends|Humans]] but the organization also included some Chiss.<ref name="The Big Find" /> Professions in the service included archaeologists, researchers, research assistants, directors, commanders, explorers, foremen, guards, engineers, scholars, special consultants, overseers, pilots, and enforcers.

===Threnoldt===
{{Quote|The Reclamation Service exists to see these threats before they destroy us, and the technologies of antiquity are our prize.|Gen. Threnoldt to Imperial heroes aboard the ''Ziost Shadow''|<ref name="Endless Horrors" />}}
[[File:General_Threnoldt.png|thumb|left|250px|Gen. Threnoldt.]]
{{Main|Threnoldt}}
Gen. Threnoldt was the commander of the Reclamation Service at least from the time between the Eternity Vault and Asation crises. As head of the Service, he had been well acquainted with Darth Thanaton, the Dark Council member for ancient knowledge, who oversaw the unit's activities.<ref name="Endless Horrors" /> Threnoldt coordinated the Empire's response to the discovery of deadly threats in Belsavis's Eternity Vault in the first year of the Galactic War and recruited the Imperial strike team that eliminated the danger. When the Empire made its first contact with the Gree Enclave, the general reported on the matter directly to the Dark Council.<ref name="New Frontiers" />

===Talos Drellik===
{{Quote|Bridging the past and the future takes such a careful hand.|Dr. Talos Drellik to the Alliance Commander|<ref name="Fighting Power With Knowledge" />}}
[[File:Talos_Drellik_on_Elom.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Dr. Talos Drellik.]]
{{Main|Talos Drellik}}
Born to a prestigious Imperial military family, Drellik enjoyed a reputation as an enthusiastic, knowledgeable, and skilled archaeologist among his peers. His first discovery was the tooth of a 4,000 year old tamed proto-[[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]. The discovery brought him to the attention of prominent Imperial scholar Dr. Auselio Gann, who took him on as a pupil. From that point, Drellik was largely engaged in researching and excavating artifacts associated with the Sith.<ref name="Lost Relics" /> In the last year of the Cold War, he supervised a Reclamation Service expedition to Hoth in search of a Sith temple later revealed to be associated with the mysterious Sadow'een. It was on that mission that he first met and later entered the direct service of the Sith Lord Kallig who later became Darth Nox and the Dark Council member for ancient knowledge. While a member of Kallig's power base, he departed in search of Dr. Gann, his former mentor, and discovered the Sith genealogical records of Vaius Antinus. After Kallig defeated Darth Thanaton and ascended to the Dark Council, Drellik adopted an old custom and pledged himself and his family to the Sith Lord and the Sith's family as loyal vassals.<ref name="Fresh Discoveries">{{TORcite|type=conversation|[[Talos Drellik]]|Fresh Discoveries}}</ref> Sometime after Nox's disappearance during the Eternal Empire's conquest, Drellik wrote his doctoral thesis on the Dashade species which earned him the title "Doctor."<ref name="Fighting Power With Knowledge" /> With the disappearance of his master, Drellik was ordered by the Dark Council to return to the Reclamation Service and lead an expedition to Yavin 4. From there he joined the Alliance in the war against Zakuul until later returning to the Empire. He deployed to Elom following Darth Malgus' capture to study local Sith ruins snd artifacts in an attempt to discern Malgus' interest in them.<ref name="Digging Deeper" />

===Auselio Gann===
{{Quote|It's the duty of the Imperial Reclamation Service to preserve this history.|Dr. Auselio Gann's last instruction to Talos Drellik concerning a Sith tomb on Aduba-6|<ref name="Finishing the Work" />}}
[[File:Auselio_Gann.png|thumb|left|250px|Dr. Auselio Gann.]]
{{Main|Auselio Gann}}
At the time of his death around the start of the Galactic War, Dr. Gann was regarded as the Reclamation Service's premier scholar on Naga Sadow. During his career, he discovered the wing of Sadow's personal [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] on Yavin 4.<ref name="Bitter Rivalries" /> Gann took Talos Drellik on as a pupil and mentored him in the history of the Sith. He perished in a Sith tomb on Aduba-6 where he was caught between Sith and Jedi seeking the tomb's secrets.

===Barden Golah===
{{Quote|—this galaxy has a lot of old secrets. Once you start seeing them... they tend to start looking back.|Cpt. Barden Golah bids farewell to Imperial heroes on Tatooine|<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" />}}
[[File:Barden_Golah_on_Dantooine.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Col. Barden Golah.]]
{{Main|Barden Golah}}
Barden Golah was an experienced Reclamation Service commander who, during the Cold War, led archaeological expeditions to Ziost, Malachor II, Nim Drovis, and Tatooine. Golah ran the day-to-day operations of the Tatooine expedition until Darth Silthar's death, after which he took charge of the team and led it until the discovery of the Imprisoned One.<ref name="Expedition into the Unknown" /> He was later promoted to colonel and led a Reclamation Service unit to Dantooine in an effort to apprehend the rogue Darth Malgus.

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Reclamation Service first appeared in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]]. Imperial player characters first encounter the Service on Dromund Kaas, the Imperial faction [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet, in the mission Into the Maw,<ref name="Into the Maw" /> though the organization is not explicitly identified by name until the mission The Accursed,<ref name="The Accursed" /> also on Dromund Kaas. The organization appears intermittently throughout the game with varying degrees of emphasis, from minor world missions to full planetary story arcs. Several game updates and expansions have included brief appearances of the Service.

===Alternate stories===
In Gen. Kolvin's mission to obtain the Infinite Engine on Nar Shaddaa, the four Imperial player characters have the Light side option to accept the Ongree servants' proposal to take a small "seed" from the engine as opposed to the device itself. The Ongree servant Azraj-Nug informs the characters that the seed will take a long time to grow and they later take the engine deeper into Revan's complex for safekeeping. Gen. Kolvin expresses dissatisfaction at this outcome.<ref name="The Infinite Engine" />

At the conclusion of the Imperial Tatooine planetary story arc, after initially defeating the Imprisoned One's ambush, Imperial characters may select the Light side option to destroy the Rakatan mind prison to contain the danger posed by the ancient intelligence. This deprives Imperial archaeologists and scientists of the ability to interact with and learn from the Imprisoned One.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" />

When Lalat'k makes his proposal to the Empire to prop him up as a dictator in the Gree Enclave in exchange for information on their technology, Imperial player characters choose the Light side option and reject the proposal. For the Sith Inquisitor character, this deprives Col. Jadick of the opportunity to lead a Reclamation Service team to Asation to study Gree tech.<ref name="New Frontiers" />

All eight player character classes have the option to complete or ignore the Fighting Power With Knowledge Alliance Alert that grants Talos Drellik as a companion. Players also have the option of rejecting Talos as a companion.<ref name="Fighting Power With Knowledge" /> Completing the alert is required to gain access to the Reclaimed Treasure alert which affords all character classes the chance to recruit Ak'ghal Usar. Usar may be rejected as a companion as well.<ref name="Reclaimed Treasure" />

At the conclusion of the ''Onslaught'' expansion, the Sith Inquisitor player character may choose the "loyalist" option to rejoin the Sith Empire for which the character's previous Sith titles and possessions as a Dark Council member are promised to be restored, or choose to keep the Alliance independent of the Empire.<ref name="Objective Meridian">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Objective Meridian|the Imperial Fleet}}</ref> If the loyalist option is selected, in Game Update 6.1 "Pinnacles of Power," the Sith Inquisitor is informed that the Reclamation Service and other assets have been transferred to the direct control of the Hand of the Empire.<ref name="The Task at Hand">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Task at Hand|[[Odessen]]}}</ref> Even in the absence of selecting the Sith Inquisitor loyalist option, the Reclamation Service is seen working closely with the Hand in future updates.

Republic player characters playing through the Secrets of the Enclave flashpoint encounter a sizable Imperial military force in the Dantooine Jedi Enclave led by Col. Golah who is also the final boss of the encounter.<ref name="Secrets of the EnclaveRep" /> Playing the same flashpoint as an Imperial character, a large Republic military force is encountered instead, implying that Col. Golah and the Reclamation Service may not have deployed to Dantooine in the Imperial arc.<ref name="Secrets of the EnclaveImp" /> Dialogue between the Imperial player characters and Col. Golah in Game Update 6.3.1 further seems to imply that in the Imperial story arc, Golah and the Service did not investigate the Dantooine enclave in place of the player character, [[Darth Rivix]], and [[Darth Krovos]].<ref name="Whispers in the Force" />

In the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|''Legacy of the Sith'']] expansion, at the conclusion of the Ruins of Nul flashpoint for either faction, Darth Malgus is captured on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] and a salvage team from the respective faction deploys to the planet to undertake a study of [[Temple of Nul|Darth Nul's temple]] and its artifacts to uncover the mystery of Darth Nul and discern Malgus' interest in the site. For Imperial player characters, this is done by a Reclamation Service team.<ref name="Ruins of Nul">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Ruins of Nul|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>  In Game Update 7.1 "Digging Deeper," characters from both factions return to the planet for an update on the excavation's findings. For Imperial characters, Dr. Talos Drellik and Col. Golah joined the team and were present when the connection between Darth Nul and the [[Children of the Emperor]] was revealed.<ref name="Digging Deeper">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Digging Deeper|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>
